ranking_rule.primary_objective: maximize sustainable realistic after-cost geometric daily growth below and above the 1% reference while satisfying survival and recoverability
ranking_rule.survival_constraint: a candidate with forced liquidation, irrecoverable account damage, or a prohibited elapsed-time liquidation cannot rank

first_place.selection_reason: The all-breakout route is the highest recorded current-exit-contract-compatible path. Its independently reproduced account grows 0.0900854% per UTC calendar day at 12bp and 0.0700189% at 24bp. It remains provisional because the execution venue is a Binance proxy, funding and exact Bybit BBO/depth are absent, 2024H1 is unopened, and winner removal destroys the path.
known_weaknesses: Binance USD-M completed bars are a proxy rather than exact Bybit execution.
Completed 60-minute bars do not reproduce tick-level stop-order triggering.
The median trade is -50bp and only 20.2% of trades win.
The five largest winners provide about 65% of positive PnL.
Removing the largest positive 10% of event keys changes the 12bp return to -26.29% and the 24bp return to -26.95%.
No official 2024H1 sequential interval was opened.
This is a non-ML benchmark and cannot satisfy the final system requirement.
Daily growth remains about 11.10 times below the 1% reference.

unranked_results.reason: Removed: maximum_hold_bars=96 defaults surviving positions to an eight-hour timeout open, a prohibited elapsed-time liquidation.
Removed: maximum_holding_minutes precommits a horizon and the executor closes surviving positions at the scheduled maximum time.
Removed: candidate.hold defines timeout_i and surviving positions exit with reason timeout.
Removed: Candidate.maximum_hold_bars is a fixed elapsed-time liquidation.
Removed: durable result status is INVALID and the positive specification contains hold=48.
Removed: the four-trade best raw path uses hold_minutes=30 and becomes negative after winner removal.
Outside the fixed four-symbol traded universe; no normalized BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP-only account path exists.
One sparse sample-day trade is not a normalized full-calendar account growth path; the model was inferior to structural distance and the trade disappears under winner removal.
Unranked negative pre-2024 account: 264 trades lost 54.49%/64.14%/71.93% at 12/18/24bp and winner removal worsened the loss.
Unranked confirmation failure: the frozen calibration scale became zero, predictions were constant zero and the account made no trade.
Unranked event-scarcity result: 116/67/8 train/calibration/confirmation events failed the population gate before model fitting.
Unranked queue-fill failure: confirmation produced zero conservative fills and fit gross returns were far below transaction cost.
Source-only result. Keyless archive endpoints could not return bounded historical LiquidationCall logs; no market outcome or alpha conclusion exists.
Other source-only probes, hard-invalid outputs and non-tradable oracles have no ranking account path.

component_rankings.reason: The 50%-queue, 3-second-TTL routing gate improved modeled five-second execution drag while remaining unsuitable as a standalone strategy.

reconciliation_notes: No new result displaced the cumulative top eight: direct utility and path continuity were economically negative, OKX was event-scarce, cross-venue maker lacked cost-sized fills, and Aave was source-unavailable.

The official 2024-2026 half-years are sequential research intervals. A promising pre-2024 path opens 2024H1 immediately, and later half-year rules may use only information available before that half-year; seen periods are not relabeled independent OOS.
Any active claim describing one frozen continuous 2024-01-01 through 2026-06-30 replay must be corrected before official outcomes open.
The current first remains a very-low-confidence non-ML benchmark about 11.10 times below the target and is not protected from replacement.
Rank does not imply economic-gate passage, deployment permission, research priority or protection.
